cohort: The study included 1,177 pregnant women (170 in the elevated MSAFP group and 1,007 in the control group) who delivered between 2009 and 2010.
finding: Elevated MSAFP levels were significantly associated with lower gestational week, birth weight, and APGAR scores, as well as increased rates of preterm delivery, PPROM, oligohydramnios, and IUGR.
